name: graft-robotics
description: Pair Claude, Antigravity, Codex, Gemini, or an offline local LLM safely with physical robots. Includes the Graft Robotics Workbench MCP App, multi-sensor LAN mesh collision checking (MuJoCo 4.0), material strength/slip mechanics, progressive L0-L3 Trust Ladder, and RFC 8785 bounded-embodiment verification.
